name: Bavdhan
civicNote: Under PMC; Bavdhan Budruk is listed in the 2017 village merger.
summary: A mainly residential suburb in south-west Pune, west of Kothrud and south of Pashan, made up largely of apartment complexes and housing societies.
knownFor: Mostly residential, with apartment complexes and housing societies
Lies between Kothrud, Pashan and Sus
connectivity: Road links to Kothrud, Paud Road, Pashan, Baner and Sus
About 14 km from Pune Junction and about 22 km from Pune airport
About 10 km from Shivajinagar railway station
suits: Families who want a residential area near Kothrud with access to both the west Pune IT belt and the city.
